name: Stormwind Keep
summary: Stormwind Keep holds the royal court above the capital. Rebuilt after its ruin in the First War, it is now home to the young boy-king Anduin Wrynn and his regent, Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.

sections.title: The Rebuilt Citadel
sections.body: Stormwind Keep crowns a plateau above the city, with halls for the crown and the kingdom’s defense. The Old Horde burned the first stronghold after King Llane was assassinated near the end of the First War. After the Alliance reclaimed the kingdom, builders raised the keep again on its old foundations. Its halls include the grand throne room and the War Room, while garden courtyards and the Royal Library offer quieter spaces.

sections.title: A Divided Court
sections.body: With King Varian Wrynn mysteriously missing on the way to a diplomatic summit at Theramore, the ten-year-old King Anduin Wrynn holds the crown. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and Lady Katrana Prestor share the work of rule. Bolvar oversees defense and military affairs, while aristocratic feuding stalls the court. The outlying territories are left vulnerable, and the crown is deeply distracted.

faq.q: Who rules in Stormwind Keep right now?
faq.answer: King Anduin Wrynn holds the throne, but at ten years old he cannot govern alone. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon rules as regent alongside Lady Katrana Prestor, the royal advisor.

faq.q: What happened to King Varian Wrynn?
faq.answer: King Varian vanished under mysterious circumstances. His disappearance left the throne vacant, so Bolvar and the court crowned young Anduin to preserve political stability.

faq.q: Was the keep destroyed in the First War?
aliases: did the orcs destroy the keep
faq.answer: Yes. After Garona murdered King Llane Wrynn, the Old Horde overwhelmed the city and razed the keep. The Alliance prevailed in the Second War, and the current fortress was rebuilt on the ancient foundations.

faq.q: What major wings can be visited inside the keep?
faq.answer: The keep holds the main throne room and the War Room directly behind it. Visitors can also find the Petitioner's Chamber, an open garden courtyard, the Royal Gallery, and the Royal Library.

angles.text: Stormwind Keep is the heart of the Alliance's eastern military command. Bolvar Fordragon and the marshals direct defenses there against rising threats across Elwynn, Westfall, and beyond.
Rebuilt from the ashes of the First War, Stormwind Keep recalls the resilience and pride of Stormwind's people.
